Latin word

cognitiō

cognitiō, cognitiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a judicial inquiry, a hearing; a notion, an idea; knowledge, finding out about a thing; getting to know, knowledge gained; hearing, judicial inquiry

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Brut. 87: diēs cognitiōnis, the day of the trial (Lewis & Short); Traupman 195

  • knowledge

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.153: cognitiō contemplātiōque nātūrae; Traupman 337, 155

  • trial

    also used · classical · Traupman 327
